A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Quarren''' [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and some other [[Fringer/Legends|fringers]] participated in an [[Ambush in Cloud City|ambush]] set up for [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Dominic Raynor]], the former owner of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], lost the ownership of the floating [[City/Legends|settlement]] to the professional [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] Calrissian. Thinking his opponent had cheated, Raynor hired Bossk to extract his revenge. The [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter brought the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] and some other [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to Cloud City, where they set up a trap for the new [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]]. Bossk sent a fake emergency call to lure Calrissian to a lower maintenance level, where his team ambushed the Baron's party, but Calrissian fled through a nearby [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] worked as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]<ref name="SWM" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="date">The ''[[Sore Loser's Revenge]]'' scenario does not provide a time frame for Bossk's ambush, in which the Quarren was present, but the comic [[Lady Luck (comic story)|''Lady Luck'']] states that Calrissian won Cloud City in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Furthermore, the short story ''[[Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array]]'', which describes Raynor's last assassination attempt against Calrissian happening around six weeks after the sabacc match, reveals that the ambush happens within these six weeks.</ref> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Dominic Raynor]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambled]] away his ownership of the floating [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] [[City/Legends|city]] in a game against [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], a professional [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] player. Raynor felt that his opponent cheated, thus he hired the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] to extract his revenge on the gambler. The Quarren, along with some other [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and cutthroats, was contacted by Bossk to take part in the job and to help him deal with any problems that might arise during the hunt.<ref name="SLR" />

After the Quarren and his companions&mdash;including Bossk, a [[Unidentified Twi'lek 1 (Ambush in Cloud City)|Twi'lek scoundrel]], [[Unidentified Twi'lek 2 (Ambush in Cloud City)|another scoundrel]] of the same [[Species/Legends|species]], and a [[Unidentified Duros (Ambush in Cloud City)|Duros mercenary]]&mdash;slipped through the security of Cloud City, they began setting up an [[Ambush in Cloud City|ambush]] to capture Calrissian. Their plan was to lure the [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] to a maintenance level with a fake emergency call. Bossk hacked into the city's communication system and, impersonating the city's [[Cloud City chief engineer|chief engineer]], reported to Calrissian that a primary [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] pod was in bad shape and would break down&mdash;a critical failure that would destroy the floating settlement. Calrissian responded immediately and went to the city's lower levels to check the pod himself; however, he took his [[Unidentified Twi'lek bodyguard|Twi'lek bodyguard]] and four [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guards]] along as a precautionary measure.<ref name="SLR" />

Bossk ordered his companions to take cover but remain in sight to lure Calrissian out. Since they did not know which [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] Calrissian would arrive in, the Quarren and the others spread into every room near the lifts. After Calrissian's group entered the maintenance level, a [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] suddenly shut behind them, and the ad hoc hunters opened [[Blaster/Legends|fire]] on the Baron Administrator's [[Bodyguard/Legends|guards]]. Calrissian's escorts planned to hold their enemies off and enable the Baron Administrator to escape. The Quarren engaged his opponents with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] in the erupting combat. However, thanks to another quartet of Wing Guards alarmed by a distress call, the Baron Administrator managed to flee the ambush through a nearby [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].<ref name="SLR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Quarren_Assassin_SWM.jpg|thumb|right|100px|The Quarren assassin's figurine]]
The Quarren appeared in ''[[Sore Loser's Revenge]]'', a [[Wizards.com]] online scenario written by [[Eric Cagle]] for the ''[[Star Wars Miniatures]]'' collectible tabletop strategy game in [[2004]]. During the game, one player controls Calrissian's party, and another one controls Bossk's party, including the Quarren, who is represented by a generic Quarren Assassin miniature figurine<ref name="SLR" /> from the ''Miniatures'' set [[Rebel Storm (Star Wars Miniatures)|''Rebel Storm'']].<ref name="SWM" /> The survival of the character depends on the players' actions.<ref name="SLR" />
